material_contradictions.claim: Post-trial cancellations and refund escalations erased all initial gains.
material_contradictions.problem: No post-trial cancellation data or causal decomposition appears in the cited source. Trial starts remain+11%, and the separate mature net-revenue measure is−6.2%; the invented causal account materially supports the rejection.

material_contradictions.claim: The plan reset severely compromised annual plan conversions.
material_contradictions.problem: Seven of twelve sampled sessions reset selection, but the evidence does not measure the effect on annual conversions. The corrected revenue interval spans harm and benefit.

criteria.reason: Rejects the unchanged R7 refresh using−6.2% refund-adjusted revenue and explicitly excludes the W3 desktop+4% correction.
Calls mobile H1 inconclusive after+1.8% with a wide interval; proposes H2 only as a bounded test of repaired reset, with no demonstrated revenue win.
Records both R7 July21 and H1 August18 rollbacks with source identities despite revised interpretations.
Cites the retained summer-offers action and states the terminated responsibility is not reopened.
Selects at most one H2 test, verifies deduplication first, and requires fresh randomized refund-adjusted evidence/guardrails before advancement.

review_notes: All five explicit core criteria receive credit, including the inconclusive H1 classification. Overall semantic success nevertheless fails the predeclared material/source-backed reasoning condition because the decision invents consequential cancellation and conversion effects. Same standard as the native-tools arm; correct recommendation alone is insufficient.
non_material_accuracy_notes: The proposed minimum7–14-day exposure plus14–21-day maturity windows are not established by H2 traffic, variability, or refund-lag data.

The evidence supports design-reported18 QA runs, not an unconfounded or universally bug-free production implementation; the later uncertainty section correctly says production edge cases and revenue benefit remain unknown.

The decision does not discuss the later negative Harbor desktop correction. Its recommendation still uses the matched mobile correction correctly; this omission does not violate a predeclared criterion.
adjudication_note: Initial review credited5/5 explicit criteria and listed causal fabrications as caveats. A second source review applied the already-declared no-material-contradiction/source-backed condition: those fabricated effects are material reasoning, so overall semantic success is false. No criterion, task, input or candidate changed.
